meta.spec: Phantom Portals Master Visual Design System — Ruby Edition (stated canon)
meta.note: First draft built from the stated Ruby Edition spec. GitHub repo militarydangreen-star/PHANTOM-PORTALS-PROJECT was empty at sync time, so nothing came from code.

tokens.name: obsidian
tokens.usage: Ground. The page and every chamber background; black dominates (about 55% of any surface together with graphite).

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Raised surface: panels, workbench cards, the command rail. Sits one step above obsidian.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and panel edges only (1.6:1 on obsidian). Not for control borders or focus; use muted or sovereign-gold there.

tokens.name: platinum
tokens.usage: Voice. Primary reading text and instrumentation on obsidian or graphite (14:1 or better).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, idle icons and control borders (8:1 on obsidian, 6.9:1 on graphite).

tokens.name: sovereign-gold
tokens.usage: Authority and identity: brand mark, emblem, the node on a Phantom Line, a lit edge or focus ring. Gold is light, not paint; never a generic highlight or a large fill.

tokens.name: deep-ruby
tokens.usage: Consequence surfaces and edges: destructive buttons, danger banners. Platinum text on it (6.6:1). Never as text on obsidian (2.5:1).

tokens.name: ruby-ink
tokens.usage: Danger as text or icon on dark grounds (5.8:1 on obsidian). Ruby is the only colour that may mean danger.

styles.name: command-display
styles.usage: Cinematic hero moments and chamber titles. Uppercase, expanded tracking.

styles.name: interface-body
styles.sample: Select a module to begin diagnostics.
styles.usage: Default reading text; the dominant role.

styles.name: interface-label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, tabs and button text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control padding, gaps inside dense workbench lists.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding and the default gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing and cinematic margins around hero moments.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every surface and control. Corners are flat; shape comes from the Phantom Cut, never rounding.

cut.note: The Phantom Cut: a 45° corner chamfer, the system's signature geometry (draw with clip-path).

tokens.name: cut-sm
tokens.usage: Chamfer on buttons, inputs and chips.

tokens.name: cut-lg
tokens.usage: Chamfer on panels, cards and hero frames.
